why: The check exists because the first pass misses things.

situation: A prototype impressed people and someone wants to announce it as available.
call: Announce only what users can touch today.
why: Announcing a prototype converts excitement into credibility debt.

call: Do the thing that was asked. Flag the adjacent thing as a suggestion; do not do it unasked.
why: Unrequested changes cost review time and hide the change that was wanted.
